content.comment_body: Hello! I would like to know if anyone has used [product_name] with versions [version_no] together with an HMI panel. My plan is to set it up with a 12" panel in a thermal installation to view operations and control some functions. Do these panels require specific software for visualization design? Also, I'm unsure how to transfer the program from [product_name] to the panel. Is it imported into the panel's software?

Hello [user_name], English is preferred in this forum. Please write your posts in English. Thank you. To answer your question: Are you referring to a [company_name] panel? If so, it's possible to use it. However, the [product_name] program runs on [product_name], not on the panel. The panel requires its own software.
Thank you for clarifying! Do these panels work with [product_name]?
Please use English if you wish to receive help. I shouldn't have to translate every post, as I do not speak Spanish.
